summary: Answers conflicted (no kids vs. 3 kids, household of 5) and income was unclear. Wife is disabled and can't work, little savings, about $450/month other income, and someone has job insurance. Tentative picks are SSI and Medicaid. A caseworker should confirm household makeup and income, then check SNAP, EITC, CTC, CHIP, school meals and the ACA credit.
